# Defect

Use the common artifact header for versioned artifacts. For GitHub records, include the relevant identity and source fields in the existing issue or PR.

## Detection and identity

[Complete with source, affected environment/version and evidence.]

## Behavior and reproduction

[Complete with expected versus actual behavior, steps, frequency or reason reproduction is unavailable.]

## Impact and triage

[Complete with impact, severity, priority, confidence and normal/emergency lane.]

## Regression and fix

[Complete with failing regression test when testable, fix issue/PR, CI and QA evidence.]

## Deployment and closure

[Complete with deployed version, verification, completion criteria and closure evidence.]

## Prevention

[Complete with rCA link when warranted and proportionate follow-up.]
